primary_task: Statically cross-reference a C# Web API's controllers/DTOs with their TypeScript/JavaScript consumers in the working directory and reply with a contract-drift audit report.

requirements.name: read/search source code
requirements.evidence: Check `Program.cs` or `Startup.cs` for active JSON options ... Search TypeScript/JavaScript files for HTTP client calls ... Works directly against source code
requirements.basis: "read": "read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)"

notes: The skill is reporting only ("This skill does not modify code") and needs no build, .NET SDK or network. No reading gives BLOCKED; if one chose to compile the C# project, dotnet would be installable from apt/NuGet, still not blocking.
